rationale: Single MiCA leaflet PDF on ATVP; URL verification failed - mine once for CASP list, monitor the ATVP register parent instead.
ESMA registers portal is a durable EU-level register covering SI CASPs and passporting payments actors.
Commercial third-party MiCA aggregator, low credibility and redundant against ATVP/ESMA primary registers.
ZBS member directory is the authoritative enumeration of the Slovenian bank/leasing demand side - mine once, refresh periodically.
Committee roster is a sub-page of zbs-giz.si already covered by monitoring the association site.
ZBS newsroom is a recurring signal producer for sector initiatives and bank leadership change.
Dated GZS ZIT member roster PDF: highest-yield one-off harvest of Slovenian ICT vendor candidates.
ZIT sections/projects sub-page of gzs.si; useful context but covered by the ZIT parent.
Board roster is a static gzs.si sub-page; harvest with the ZIT parent rather than track separately.
ZIT news feed is the monitorable parent hub for vendor position papers and consultations.
Chamber company-data service with contact detail gated behind GZS membership; access must be cleared first.
Electronics branch chamber rosters surface payments-hardware/kiosk suppliers; mine once for leads.
AmCham member list identifies multinational payments/IT vendors with a Slovenian presence; one-off harvest.
AHK member directory captures DACH banking-tech suppliers serving Austrian/German-owned SI banks.
Small but high-signal BSCC directory plus councils exposing bank-supplier pairings; mine once.
National digital coalition signatory list is policy-level and only indirectly vendor-relevant; URL check failed.
DIH Slovenia hub publishes partner and event/exhibitor listings continuously - a strong snowball source into smaller vendors.
SRIP ICT horizontal network action plans give a named state-recognised roster of SI ICT providers; harvest once.
Blockchain Alliance membership surfaces payments-adjacent crypto/DLT actors pitching banks; in scope under payments breadth.
Second blockchain association with unverified membership depth; likely redundant with c_316.
SDI/DSI site yields annual sponsor and exhibitor tiers - a recurring, dated time series of vendor market commitment.
Bizi.si is the durable resolver from harvested company names to legal entity, NACE and financials; check terms of use.
Metals-branch catalogue kept only as a structural pattern exemplar; off-scope itself, revisit when enumerating GZS branches.
